name: Baris Soybilgen
lede: I build machine-learning models and LLM applications for the business and its customers. Alongside that, I do research on forecasting: nowcasting GDP, inflation and unemployment from high-frequency data, and reading business cycles with machine learning. I have also written on monetary policy, labour markets, financial crises and, most recently, how AI changes the demand for knowledge work.
description: Economist and data scientist in Stockholm. Research on nowcasting, business cycles and forecasting; open-source code; posts on Turkish markets.

about.heading: An economist who ships the code behind the model.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Data Scientist at Sambla Group in Stockholm. I lead customer-facing generative AI applications used by mobile app customers in three markets, and I build LLM tools on company data, customer-level revenue models and marketing mix models.

I started my career in Turkey, forecasting the economy at Betam. Next came Istanbul Bilgi University, where as an assistant professor I taught and built deep-learning and statistical models for macro-finance forecasting and high-frequency indicators of the Turkish economy. I then moved to Sweden, where I analysed survey data at the Governance and Local Development Institute in Gothenburg before joining Sambla Group.

work.product: Sam, the AI assistant in the Sambla app
work.intro: One of the customer-facing generative AI applications I lead at Sambla Group is Sam, the AI financial assistant in the Sambla app. Customers ask it about loans, interest rates, credit scores and budgeting, in plain language and at any hour.
points: Explains loan terms such as effective interest, amortisation and fees, and what changes when the term, amount or repayment pace changes.
Knows the app and the market it serves: it explains how the UC credit score works in Sweden and takes customers straight to their own score in the app.
Tells customers when they are talking to AI, and hands complex or sensitive cases to a human advisor.

screens.alt: Sam's start screen: "Hi, I'm Sam! I can help you with your personal finance questions", with a note that answers are generated by AI.
A customer asks Sam how to improve their credit score; Sam lists the key factors, such as paying bills on time.
Sam explains how UC credit scores work in Sweden and offers a "See my credit score" button.
